blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: That was the advantage.
exercises.why: After the verbs быть (past and future) and работать the noun indicating some person's occupation, rank or position is in the instrumental case: *Он был (будет) офицером. Я работаю переводчиком. Он хочет быть врачом.* Do not use the instrumental in such constructions as: *Это был офицер. Это была учительница. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book. Lesson 30.  ·  «After the verbs быть (past and future) and работать the noun indicating some person's occupation, rank or position is in the instrumental case.» — DLI, Lesson 30.
